_readme: Copy this file to sources.json. Each entry is one feed the watcher polls.
name: label shown on the dashboard (also the key for fresh_days).
type: rss (RSS 2.0 or Atom) | shopify (a store's /products.json?limit=250) | woot (Woot developer API; put the key in woot_api_key.txt) | bradsdeals_html (the bradsdeals.com/deals tile page).
url: the feed address. For a feed whose address is itself a secret (a per-account alert feed), use url_file instead: the name of a file in this folder holding the address. Keep that file out of git.
enabled: optional, false skips the source.
fresh_days: optional, how many days a row from this source stays on the main page after the feed last listed it (default 7). A one-deal-a-day site wants 2.
A search on a deal site that offers RSS for any query becomes its own rss entry, one per thing you want searched.
